title: The River Inside You
intro: This quiz explores how the circulatory system moves blood, oxygen, and nutrients throughout the body.

questions.prompt: What is the main job of the heart?
choices: To pump blood around the body
questions.explanation: The heart's main job is to pump blood around the body.

questions.prompt: Which blood vessels carry blood away from the heart?
questions.explanation: Arteries carry blood away from the heart.

questions.prompt: Which blood vessels carry blood back toward the heart?
questions.explanation: Veins carry blood back toward the heart.

questions.prompt: What happens in the tiny blood vessels called capillaries?
choices: Oxygen and nutrients move from the blood into body cells
Food is broken into smaller pieces
questions.explanation: In capillaries, oxygen and nutrients move from the blood into body cells.

questions.prompt: Why does the heart beat faster during exercise?
choices: The muscles need more oxygen and nutrients
questions.explanation: The heart beats faster during exercise because the muscles need more oxygen and nutrients.
